diagnostics.help: Use `.flatMap(item => condition ? [value] : [])` to change and drop items in one pass, instead of building a throwaway array in between

diagnostics.title: Redundant padding axes
diagnostics.message: px-5 & py-5 are the same.
diagnostics.help: Collapse `px-N py-N` to `p-N` when both sides match. Keep them split only when one side changes at a breakpoint (`py-2 md:py-3`).

diagnostics.title: Array lookup inside a loop
diagnostics.message: This gets slow because array.includes() inside a loop scans the whole list every time, so use a Set for instant lookups
diagnostics.help: Use a `Set` or `Map` when you check for the same items over and over. `Array.includes`/`find` scans the whole list each time
